data.title: KSrelief Continues Supplying Safe Drinking Water to Displaced Persons in Yemen's Taiz
data.content:
Taiz, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) supplied safe drinking water through 13 distribution points in Taiz Governorate, Yemen, on Wednesday, benefiting 500 families, as part of the emergency response project to provide drinking water to displaced persons in Taiz.
    These humanitarian and relief projects, implemented by Saudi Arabia through KSrelief, aim to improve living conditions, provide safe drinking water, strengthen community resilience, and create favorable conditions for recovery in Yemen.
    -- SPA
22:15 Local Time 19:15 GMT
